data.gender_notes: Malkeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Malkeet is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Mal' meaning moon and 'Ketu' meaning power or shadow. In Hindu mythology, Ketu is a planet that represents spiritual growth and transformation. The name Malkeet signifies the power of the moon god, which brings wisdom, intuition, and protection. The name Malkeet carries the meaning “Moon God's Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Malkeet usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
